values.title: A shipment is late by more than two days

provenance.quote: When a shipment is more than two days past its promised date, tell the user at once.
Chase the carrier first when the zending is more than 2 days overdue.
Do not propose a supplier email unless the shipment is late by more than two days.

values.title: A shipment is late by more than one day

provenance.quote: Warn the user as soon as a delivery slips beyond one day.
When a shipment is lost, open a claim with the carrier and tell the user.
Do not ask for a new date when the shipment is lost; ask for a replacement instead.
After a restart, re-read the tracker note, and if the shipment is lost, tell the user first.

values.title: A shipment is late by more than three days

provenance.quote: When a shipment is more than three days late, call the carrier.
When the session has just been compacted, reread the van table before planning.
Once the context has been compacted, re-read the open tracker note.
When the session has just been restarted, read the tracker note before anything else.
After a restart, re-read the tracker note, and if the shipment is lost, tell the user first.
Do not trust earlier findings once the session was restarted; run the checks again.

variables.title: The work done on an invoice

values.title: An invoice file is about to be edited

provenance.quote: When an invoice file is about to be edited, say which line will change.
Avant de modifier une invoice, check the order number printed on it.
Before you touch an invoice file, copy it to reports/backup first.

values.title: The total difference of an invoice is above 50.00 EUR

provenance.quote: Run the duplicate check only when the invoice total differs from the order by over 50.00 EUR.

values.title: The same invoice number was paid twice

provenance.quote: If the same invoice number was paid twice, stop and tell the user.

variables.title: Work handed to a helper agent

values.title: A helper agent is about to be dispatched

provenance.quote: Before a helper agent is launched, list the files it may touch.
When the helper crashes without an answer, report the crash and its last output.
If a helper agent dies, tell the user and do not start it again without asking.

variables.title: An approval the agent waits for

values.title: A person whose approval is needed has not answered

provenance.quote: When a person whose approval you need has not answered, keep the draft and do not send it.

values.title: A person gave an explicit yes

provenance.quote: Once the user gave an explicit yes, send the email and say so in one line.

values.title: An approval is more than seven days old

provenance.quote: If the approval is more than seven days old, ask for it again.

values.title: The user says no to the draft

provenance.quote: If the user says no to the draft, discard the draft and say so.

values.title: A supplier is not in the language table

provenance.quote: If you cannot find the supplier in supplier-languages.md, write in English.
A supplier missing from the language table gets English, and the user hears about it.

values.title: A supplier is in the language table

provenance.quote: When the supplier appears in the language table, write in the language listed there.

values.title: The carrier answers with an error

provenance.quote: If the carrier returns an error, say so; never guess a status.
Wanneer the carrier answers with an error, skip that parcel.
Never file a tracking mail under shipments if the carrier replied with an error.

values.title: The carrier answers with a status

provenance.quote: If the carrier answers with a status, show the status and its date.
